set.body: Full R CMD check of an isolated Git source plus the partial-stopping patch exposed two baseline packaging defects: test-bench-protocol.R passes unquoted script/output/caps paths to system2, failing on My Passport; admission tests require two raw-worker archives excluded by the blanket *.tar.gz ignore. Both local archives exactly match the committed admission ledger MD5 and SHA256. Quote subprocess arguments and exercise a space-containing output path; track only these exact required archives with narrow ignore exceptions. Do not rewrite the historical admission ledger or claim release promotion. Acceptance: source-only tar build and full package check pass, with exact archive checksums and unrelated local state preserved.
set.title: Make package benchmark checks reproducible from Git and paths with spaces
